items.title: Milt Hinton interviewed by Joe Williams, Majesty of the Seas, May 31, 1995
items.q: Johnny Dodds? Johnny Dodds. Thank you, thank you. Johnny Dodds and those cats man, they were something. He came over and when you hear him... then you know where Benny came from and where he was.

ctx.x: And what were those two brothers, one played drums I think and the other played clarinet. MW: Johnny Dodds?

Johnny Dodds. Thank you, thank you. Johnny Dodds and those cats man, they were something. He came over and when you hear him, if you hear them as you and I did, then you know where Benny came from and where he was. Like “I Know That You Know,” [scats] that stuff he plays all that intricate stuff he plays, man came right out of him, and the lower register things Woody he played.
